title: Types of Decimal Expansion
body: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800"><style>.title{font-family:serif;font-size:50px;fill:#d4af37;text-anchor:middle;font-weight:bold}.head{font-family:serif;font-size:30px;fill:#d4af37;text-anchor:middle;font-weight:bold}.text{font-family:serif;font-size:28px;fill:white;text-anchor:middle}.example{font-family:serif;font-size:32px;fill:#60a5fa;text-anchor:middle}.line{stroke:#d4af37;stroke-width:3;opacity:.6}</style><rect x="50" y="50" width="1100" height="700" rx="40" fill="#101827" fill-opacity=".85" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="3"/><text x="600" y="120" class="title">Types of Decimal Expansion</text><rect x="120" y="170" width="960" height="500" rx="20" fill="#162943" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="3"/><line x1="360" y1="170" x2="360" y2="670" class="line"/><line x1="700" y1="170" x2="700" y2="670" class="line"/><line x1="120" y1="290" x2="1080" y2="290" class="line"/><line x1="120" y1="415" x2="1080" y2="415" class="line"/><line x1="120" y1="540" x2="1080" y2="540" class="line"/><text x="240" y="245" class="head">Type</text><text x="530" y="245" class="head">Example</text><text x="890" y="245" class="head">What happens?</text><text x="240" y="365" class="text">Terminating</text><text x="530" y="365" class="example">0.25</text><text x="890" y="365" class="text">Digits stop</text><text x="240" y="490" class="text">Repeating</text><text x="530" y="490" class="example">0.333...</text><text x="890" y="470" class="text">Pattern repeats</text><text x="890" y="505" class="text">forever</text><text x="240" y="615" class="text">Non-repeating</text><text x="530" y="615" class="example">√2 = 1.414...</text><text x="890" y="595" class="text">No repeating</text><text x="890" y="630" class="text">pattern</text></svg>
